jobs.description:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

The position requires a physical presence at our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data.

In this role, you will focus on:

• 
Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

• 
Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

• 
Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them.

• 
Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

• 
Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

• 
Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

• 
Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

• 
Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI.

• 
Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

• 
Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

• 
Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

• 
AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

• 
Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

• 
Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

• 
Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages.

What We Offer

• 
Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

• 
A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

• 
A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.

• 
Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Help us build the next generation of lifting and transport equipment for the wind industry

We're looking for an experienced Automation Engineer who wants to take responsibility for control systems, PLC software and machine automation.

This is a newly established role at Danhydra, where you will help strengthen automation across future products and development projects.

The role

Some days you will be working with PLC software and control architecture. Other days you may be reviewing functional safety requirements, troubleshooting on a test setup, supporting commissioning activities, or discussing technical solutions with suppliers and colleagues from production and engineering.

You will work closely with colleagues within hydraulics, mechanics and electrical engineering to develop robust and reliable machine control solutions.

Your responsibilities

•    Develop PLC and HMI software using Siemens TIA Portal

•    Define automation concepts and system architecture for new products

•    Translate functional and safety requirements into practical control solutions

•    Support testing, troubleshooting and commissioning activities

•    Specify and integrate sensors, electrical components and control hardware

•    Work closely with colleagues within hydraulics, mechanics and electrical engineering

•    Contribute to machine safety design and compliance with Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

•    Support technical dialogue with suppliers and development partners

What we're looking for

You have experience from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, automation systems or similar technical environments.

You have worked with systems where software, hydraulics, electrical components and mechanics need to work together reliably under demanding operating conditions.

We expect that you:

•    Have experience with Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal

•    Understand industrial control systems and machine automation

•    Can translate functional requirements into practical control solutions

•    Work well across different engineering disciplines

•    Take responsibility for your work and follow tasks through to completion

Experience with hydraulic control systems, proportional valves, pressure and flow control, or closed-loop regulation will be considered a strong advantage.

Why join Danhydra?

At Danhydra, we develop and manufacture specialised lifting, transportation and installation equipment used throughout the global wind industry.

With more than 25 years of experience in the wind industry and approximately 160 employees across Denmark, Germany, Spain, India and the United States, we continue to develop equipment that helps customers handle some of the industry's largest and most demanding components.

You will join a team where technical decisions are made close to the engineering work and where practical solutions matter.

Interested?

We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews until we find the right candidate.

If you would like to learn more about the position, please apply.

For any inquiries regarding the position, please contact the desigated job representative

jobs.occupation: Administrative Coordinator for Post fixture assistance in Bioenergy
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where play an important role in supporting our team of logistics coordinators in their daily work

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a department handling more than 550 import vessels and 25,000 biomass truck deliveries annually to our power plants across Denmark. Our team ensures that our power plants always have the feedstock they need, enabling Ørsted to deliver heat and power to local communities. Looking ahead, logistics will also play a significant role in the transportation of CO₂, adding an exciting new dimension to our responsibilities. We work cross-departmental in the company with e.g. Fuel Procurement, Back Office, Finance and Sustainability who all rely on our swift, accurate and efficient support.

**Welcome to Bioenergy - Customers & Markets

**You’ll be part of Shipping & Logistics where you, together with your colleagues, will contribute to respective areas of expertise when needed. In-depth SAP knowledge, confidence in creating and managing purchase orders, and the ability to handle fast-track payments are important parts of the role. Strong Excel skills and a competitive commercial mindset is essential. Knowledge and experience within shipping and logistics is a clear advantage, and you must be able to read and understand contracts, to ensure operations are carried out in accordance with the agreed terms. As a team, we are six colleagues with a flat organizational structure, where collaboration, trust, flexibility and a willingness to help one another are essential to how we work.

You’ll play an important role in:

• providing fundamental input and improvement suggestions to enhance efficiency and optimize processes incl. preparing and developing PowerPoint presentations for internal and external use

• contributing to the continued growth of Bioenergy and supporting the department’s commercial and operational activities

• acting as the department’s SAP expert, requiring in-depth knowledge and understanding of relevant SAP processes and functionalities

• independently creating and maintaining purchase orders and ensuring accurate and timely administration

• performing post-fixture activities, including laytime calculations, port turnaround figures for both own and external vessels, and tonnage reporting

• collaborating, both verbally and in writing in Danish and English, with shipowners, operators, brokers, surveyors, truck haulers and other external partners, as well as colleagues across the Orsted organization.

To succeed in the role, you:

• are a Team player and at the same time strive working independently

• laugh easily and appreciate an informal tone and further more you possess curiosity and willingness to learn

• love fast pace at work and are not afraid of being challenged even though it might be out of your comfortzone

• possess a thorough practical knowledge of SAP and Excel

• think and act commercially and know how to calculate in days, hours and minutes (laytime)

• see yourself growing as the position is a natural stepping stone towards a Logistics Coordinator role, where you gradually will take on more responsibility and a broader range of independent tasks.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range: For this position, the expected base pay range is according to collective agreement relevant for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Digital Solutions (Web & Martech Platforms)
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Solutions (Web & Martech Platforms) to join our centralized Web & Martech Hub within the Data, Digital & AI organization. The role will play a key part in enabling Genmab's EU and International digital expansion while driving adoption and effective use of our enterprise Web and Martech platforms.

As a member of the Hub team, this role will partner with regional Spoke teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate market needs into scalable platform capabilities, enable adoption of common standards and reusable solutions, and support the continued evolution of our Web and Martech ecosystem, including the implementation of Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Edge Delivery Services.

**Responsibilities

**

• Serve as a key Hub partner for EU and International Web & Martech initiatives, working with regional stakeholders to understand market needs and enable successful adoption of enterprise digital platforms and capabilities.

• Support the continued expansion of Genmab's Hub-and-Spoke model by enabling regional teams to effectively consume Hub-provided platforms, reusable components, standards, and delivery practices.

• Play a key role in the implementation and evolution of AEM and Edge Delivery Services, including planning, prioritization, and enablement of reusable components and capabilities required across global and regional websites.

• Partner closely with the Platform Architect, Design Agency of Record, business stakeholders, and implementation partners to translate business and market requirements into scalable and reusable Web capabilities.

• Support platform management and enablement across the broader Web & Martech ecosystem, including AEM, Salesforce Experience Cloud, GA4/GTM, OneTrust, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and other supporting technologies.

• Partner with Data Privacy, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure platform capabilities and implementations align with enterprise, security, privacy, and design standards.

• Work with technology and delivery partners, including HCL, to coordinate platform enhancements, component development, market enablement, and implementation activities.

• Identify common requirements across markets and promote reuse of components, templates, integrations, and established platform patterns rather than market-specific solutions.

• Support platform roadmaps, demand prioritization, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement based on business needs and market feedback.

• Develop and maintain platform guidance, playbooks, and enablement materials to help Spoke teams adopt Web & Martech capabilities consistently and efficiently.

• Act as a bridge between EU/International stakeholders and the broader Web & Martech Hub, ensuring requirements, dependencies, risks, and decisions are effectively coordinated.

**Requirements

**

• 12+ years of experience in digital platforms, enterprise Web, Martech, product/platform management, technology delivery, or related roles.

• Strong understanding of enterprise Web platforms, component-based development, and modern digital delivery practices.

• Experience working with global and regional stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations.

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and coordinate across architecture, engineering, design, business, and delivery teams.

• Experience working with Agile delivery models and external technology or implementation partners.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to combine sufficient technical depth with strong business, platform management, and delivery capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience with Adobe Experience Manager / Edge Delivery Services, Salesforce Experience Cloud, or comparable enterprise CMS/DXP platforms.

• Exposure to Martech technologies such as GA4, GTM, OneTrust, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

• Experience with reusable component libraries, design systems, or component-driven Web development.

• Experience with Hub-and-Spoke or other federated platform operating models.

• Experience supporting European and/or international digital initiatives and working across multiple markets.

The proposed gross annual/monthly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR0,00---0,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the contract.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in Computational Lexicography and Linguistics at the Centre for Language Technology, Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics, UCPH
jobs.description:
The Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics, Faculty of Humanities, University of Copenhagen (UCPH), Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral fellowship in Computational Lexicography and Linguistics to be filled by the 1st of March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics is home to 1600 students and 160 members of staff. It provides the setting for international research and education from BA to PhD studies within language, language technology, Natural Language Processing, literature, media, culture, and gender studies.

  The successful candidate will be attached to both the Centre for Language Technology (CST), which is one of the research centres of the department, and to the Society of Danish language and Literature (DSL) which compiles and publishes dictionaries and language technology resources for Danish at a scholarly basis, often in research projects in collaboration with CST. The latter affiliation will amount to around six months of the total hiring period of 24 months.

  CST conducts research in different areas of interest for language technology, such as Natural Language Processing, construction of NLP resources, Computational Cognitive Modeling and Multimodality, NLP infrastructure and policy, Representation Learning for NLP and Digital Humanities, among others.  It has a strong international profile, at the same time as pursuing the development of language technology methods and resources for the Danish language. The Centre has considerable experience managing international research projects, frequently attracts visiting researchers, and has organised major conferences in the field. In collaboration with the Department of Computer Science at the University of Copenhagen, it offers an international MSc programme in IT and Cognition. The programme, which currently admits about 30 students a year, comprises a range of courses in Natural Language Processing and Cognitive Science. In addition, we teach at several BA programs and electives, such as the BA ‘Kognitions- and Datavidenskab’ hosted at the Department of Psychology and an elective package on Language-Centric AI for students in the Humanities.

  Job content
 The successful candidate will contribute to the project ELEXAI, which focuses on a European Lexicographic Infrastructure for Artificial Intelligence (https://www.eurac.edu/en/projects/elexai), granted by the European Commission under the Horizon Europe Program.

  The candidate will in particular contribute to the project’s work packages on LLM Benchmarking, the so-called LexBench, which is led by CST and also involves DSL. This part of the project investigates how benchmarks for Natural Language Understanding can be compiled mono- and multilingually from lexical resources and datasets. The position involves designing and compiling such benchmarks in close collaboration with DSL and the other European partners of the project and to apply them in diverse evaluation scenarios. A particular focus will be put on benchmarking word understanding capabilities and on the understanding of figurative language, including the cultural bias that this part of the language may evoke in LLMs.

  Ideal candidates for this work have a background in computational lexicography and/or computational linguistics, with experience in lexicographical work and with good programming skills. It is an advantage although not a requirement, if the candidate has good knowledge of the Danish language.

  Teaching qualifications are not a requirement, since the candidate will not be involved in teaching.

  Qualification requirements
 Applicants will primarily be assessed on their research qualifications, including publications, the ability to conduct independent research and participate in research collaborations, and experience in research management. In addition, the applicant’s research plan and research potential will be assessed in relation to the project described above. 

  Application
 Applications must be submitted online in PDF or Word format. Click on the “Apply now” button at the bottom of this advertisement to apply.

  Applications should be written English and must include the following attachments:  

   	
• Letter of motivation 	
• CV  	
• Documentation of qualifications (exam certificates and PhD diploma)  	
• Complete publication list (attached publications must be marked with an asterisk). The list must be structured systematically and divided into the following categories:    	
• Peer-reviewed publications:  	 		
• Monographs and anthologies 		
• Articles in journals 		
• Book chapters/anthology contributions, etc. 	 	 	
• Non-peer-reviewed publications: 	 		
• Publications disseminating research findings, etc. 	 	   Applicants can attach a maximum of 4 publications. The publication dates must be clearly marked on the list. The selected publications must be uploaded as attachments and numbered [1-4]. 

   	
• Research plan. 	
• Work on the dissemination of research.   Only documentation in English will be assessed.  

  Applicants are invited to familiarize themselves with the faculty’s strategic landmarks here: Strategic landmarks – University of Copenhagen (ku.dk)

  Salary and terms of employment
 Terms of appointment and salary will be in accordance with an agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). The salary range starts at DKK 39.993,75 (EUR 5.350,62) + a 18,07% contribution to the pension scheme. It is possible to negotiate salary supplements on an annual basis.

  The recruitment process
 Once the deadline for applications has expired, the Head of Section will consider advice from the appointment committee and select applicants for assessment. All applicants will be notified whether they have been shortlisted. The Head of Section will then set up an expert assessment committee to consider the applications. The selected applicants will be informed who is serving on the committee. They will be offered the opportunity to comment on the committee’s assessment of their application before the appointment is announced.

  Further information on the recruitment process at University of Copenhagen can be found here:  Recruitment process – University of Copenhagen (ku.dk)

  An Equal Opportunity Workplace
 The University of Copenhagen is committed in its pursuit of academic excellence to equality of opportunity and to creating an inclusive working environment and therefore encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, ethnicity etc. For more on the diverse working place environment at the University and the University’s participation in the HRS4R HR Excellence in Research, see HR Excellence in Research – University of Copenhagen (ku.dk)

  International applicant?
 The University of Copenhagen offers a wide variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including support before and during your relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about these services as well as information on entering and working in Denmark, here: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen (ku.dk)

  Contact information
 Information about the recruitment process is available from HR SOENDRE, email:HR-SOENDRE@adm.ku.dk, please refer to ID number: 211-2697/26-2L

  Additional information about the position can be obtained from Professor Bolette S. Pedersen, email: bspedersen@hum.ku.dk, The deadline for applications is 30 November 2026, 23:59 [CET] 

  Any applications or additional material submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

Do you have a strong drive, a strategic mindset, and a passion for turning financial insights into business impact? Are you motivated by working at the intersection of finance, strategy and performance management?

“You will take ownership of the financial reporting and performance management of Arla's continuous improvement programme, Fund our Future, while also supporting important strategic processes across the business. As a trusted finance partner, you will influence decision-making and help strengthen Arla's ability to deliver on its long-term strategic ambitions,” says Theis Engedal Pedersen, Strategic Finance Director.

**

How you will make an impact**

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, this is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly engaged Strategic Finance team of eight colleagues and be part of Arla's wider Performance Management organization. Based in Aarhus, Denmark, you will operate across functions and organizational levels, partnering closely with Finance, Group Strategy and business stakeholders globally. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the financial reporting and performance management of Fund our Future, ensuring transparency, high-quality reporting and a strong focus on value delivery

• Safeguarding efficiency principles across the various efficiency streams and supporting target setting, performance follow-up and problem solving where needed

• Supporting Group Strategy in running the annual strategy wheel, including co-driving deliverables, insight generation and decision material for business planning and strategic follow-up towards Executive Management and Board of Directors

• Assessing performance against long-term strategic ambitions and targets, translating data and analysis into actionable recommendations for leadership

**

What will make you successful**

We are looking for a finance professional with strong business acumen and a desire to create impact through financial insights and strategic thinking. We imagine the ideal candidate brings:

• 6+ years of experience from relevant finance or strategy functions, such as finance business partnering, performance management, business finance, consulting or corporate strategy

• A relevant university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to both dive into details and zoom out to understand the bigger picture

• Solid financial understanding combined with the ability to connect financial performance with operational, commercial and strategic drivers

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to condense complexity into precise and compelling executive messaging

• A collaborative mindset and proven ability to build strong relationships across teams and organizational levels

As a person, you are curious, proactive and execution oriented. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders and are comfortable balancing strategic discussions with hands-on analytical work. You are a natural relationship builder who can challenge and support stakeholders while maintaining focus on delivering results.

**

What do we offer?**

Joining Strategic Finance means becoming part of a team with a central role in Arla’s performance management and strategic agenda. You will work at the intersection of finance, performance management and strategy, with exposure to a broad range of stakeholders and the opportunity to influence important business decisions and contribute directly to Arla’s long-term success. You will join a young, highly engaged and collaborative team with a strong focus on personal and professional development.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to turn financial insights into strategic impact and help shape the future of dairy, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Theis Engedal Pedersen Director of Strategic Finance, on +45 9131 4630

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Contact Us

Do you want a role with a clear sense of purpose, working with mission-critical technology that supports defence organisations and their ability to operate, collaborate and make well-informed decisions in complex environments?

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Greenland’s Firn Tipping Point - DTU Space
jobs.description:
Are you interested in turning natural phenomena into equations and code, and then applying them to big open questions in climate science? If so, we are looking for a PhD student with a background in physics and/or mathematics to help predict when Greenland’s porous near-surface firn layer, which currently stores much of the ice sheet’s meltwater, loses that capacity, and what that means for sea-level rise.

You will build models that combine physics, machine learning, and satellite data, and apply them to climate scenarios from the EU’s Destination Earth initiative. You will join a diverse and collaborative group at DTU Space and develop skills in scientific computing and machine learning that are valued in both research and industry. No prior experience in glaciology or climate science is needed; we will help you learn the field.

Responsibilities and qualifications
In the FirnTip project, you will develop a framework that predicts when and where Greenland’s firn stops being able to store meltwater, a possible climate tipping point. You will work closely with your supervisors at DTU Space as well as international partners. 

Your main tasks will be to:

• Identify which climate factors control when firn stops absorbing meltwater
• Combine satellite-derived firn density with firn models (data assimilation)
• Develop machine-learning models (e.g., graph neural networks) that obey physical conservation laws.
• Detect early-warning signals of tipping points in future climate scenarios
• Spend 3-6 months aboard visiting international partners, planned in collaboration with you
• Take part in teaching and knowledge-sharing as part of the DTU PhD program
To do well in the role, we think you need:

• A master’s degree in physics, mathematics or a field with a comparable mathematical foundation
• Experience writing scientific code, e.g., from your thesis or projects
• Good knowledge of at least one of: differential equations, numerical methods, statistics, or machine learning
• Good written and spoken English
Experience with glaciology, remote sensing, or machine learning is not required.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be conducted by Senior Researcher Sebastian B. Simonsen (DTU), Researcher Kirk M. Scanlan (DTU), and Senior Researcher Anja Rutishauser (GEUS) using common criteria for all applicants. Shortlisted applicants will have a structured interview, possibly including a short computational exercise. If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications, please still apply. Let us know if you need any adjustments to the recruitment process. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The start date is February 1st or soon thereafter.

The position is a full-time position.

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Senior Scientist Sebastian B. Simonsen, ssim@dtu.dk. Questions about the project or the application are welcome. 

You can read more about our DTU Space cryosphere research at https://www.space.dtu.dk/english/research-divisions/geodesy-and-earth-observation/research-areas/cryosphere

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 29 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A one-page description of a computational or mathematical project you have done (e.g., your MSc thesis): the problem, your methods and your own contribution.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates, irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background, are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

You will join the Cryosphere Research Group in the Geodesy and Earth Observation Division at DTU Space, Lyngby Campus. We use satellites, models and on-the-ground measurements to understand how ice sheets and glaciers are changing and what this means for sea level, in projects for ESA and the EU. Our group is international and collaborative, and we value curiosity, good supervision and a healthy work-life balance. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant, S&OP/IBP - Global Supply Chain Planning & Analytics
jobs.description:
_Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to gain hands-on experience in global supply chain planning? Do you enjoy working with data, generating insights, and supporting business decision-making?

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain. In this role, you will contribute to the monthly planning cycle and metal hedging process through data consolidation, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

You will take ownership of selected recurring deliverables and support the improvement of planning tools, inventory management, data quality, and processes across Global Supply Chain.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), supply chain analytics, inventory planning, and process improvement in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain valuable insight into how data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration drive operational and commercial decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Consolidate data and prepare reports, analyses, and meeting materials for the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle.

• Take ownership of selected recurring reports and data-consolidation activities.

• Develop and maintain planning tools, dashboards, KPIs, and inventory projections with guidance from the team.

• Support the metal hedging process by consolidating forecasts, conducting analyses, preparing decision materials, and coordinating stakeholder input.

• Analyze inventory, production, and supply chain performance and translate data into clear business insights.

• Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, stakeholder input, action tracking, and follow-up.

• Contribute to improvements in planning processes, reporting, automation, and data quality.

• Support ad hoc analyses and tasks as required.

**Your Team

**You will join the S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain and report to the S&OP/IBP Manager. The team collaborates closely with stakeholders across Crafting & Supply, Global Treasury, and other areas within Global Supply Chain to support planning, decision-making, and business performance.

As part of the team, you will gain first-hand experience with how integrated planning processes connect demand, supply, inventory, and financial considerations across a global organization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

• Ideally have at least one year remaining of your studies.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, Power Query, and working with large datasets.

• Comfortable working with data and translating it into meaningful insights.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with BI, ERP, MRP, WMS, reporting, or planning tools is considered an advantage.

• Previous full-time work experience is not required. Relevant experience gained through student employment, internships, university projects, or similar activities is considered an advantage.

• An interest in automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled planning processes is considered a plus.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical and curious, with a strong interest in supply chain planning, S&OP, and Integrated Business Planning.

• Structured and detail-oriented in your approach to tasks and problem-solving.

• Proactive and eager to learn, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for assigned deliverables.

• A clear and confident communicator.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Able to balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, and global supply chain processes.

• Opportunities to work with data consolidation, reporting, analysis, and inventory planning.

• Insight into the metal hedging process and the coordination of forecasts and stakeholder input.

• Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across Global Supply Chain, Crafting & Supply, and Global Treasury.

• Opportunities to develop your Excel, analytical, and business communication skills.

• Experience taking ownership of recurring reports and deliverables.

• The opportunity to contribute to improvements in planning processes, automation, reporting, and data quality.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Are you curious about how products go from idea to market in a global technology company? As a Student Worker in Product Management, you will help shape solutions for the international air-conditioning and refrigeration industry while gaining hands-on experience in a business-critical function.

In this role, you will support product development, market analysis, product launches, and supplier collaboration. Your work will help transform customer and market insights into actions that create value for customers around the world.

You will join Danfoss Climate Solutions and work closely with experienced colleagues across functions and geographies. This is an opportunity to develop both your commercial and technical understanding while building a strong professional network in an international environment.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Support product development and launch activities by coordinating inputs, documentation, and follow-up actions to help projects move forward successfully.

• Research market trends, customer needs, and competitor developments to identify insights and business opportunities.

• Collaborate with colleagues and suppliers to align activities and ensure smooth execution across functions.

• Prepare presentations, business analyses, and product information that support decision-making and communication.

• Contribute to portfolio and product-management activities by organizing information and helping drive key initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**

• You are currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor's or master's program and can combine your studies with approximately 12-15 working hours per week.

• You have a strong interest in product management, technology, business development, and international markets.

• You have an analytical and structured approach and enjoy working with data, information, and business insights.

• You communicate clearly in English and can collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.

• You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll gain practical experience in an international product management environment where your contributions have real impact.

You will have the opportunity to learn about product development, product launches, portfolio management, supplier collaboration, and business development while working alongside experienced professionals. We believe in learning through responsibility, and you will gradually take ownership of your own tasks and projects.

This position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark, with flexible working arrangements that support your studies and provide additional flexibility during examination periods.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited about combining business, technology, and market insights in a global organization, we'd love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply and share how your skills and perspective can contribute to the team.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Forensics Solutions Activation Leader Associate Director
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Location: European hubs (flexible)

Level: Associate Director

Employment type: Permanent, full time

**Role Summary

**We are seeking a commercially minded, market-facing leader to drive the growth and adoption of our portfolio of digitally enabled and AI-enhanced forensic solutions across Europe, with extension into APAC. Our Integrity & Compliance solution is a flagship offering within this portfolio and will feature prominently — but the role spans the wider set of technology-led forensic solutions we need to commercialise.

The central purpose of the role is market activation: helping country and regional Forensics teams move from traditional, manual delivery to modern, technology-led ways of serving clients — and, in doing so, unlocking new revenue. The successful candidate will partner with local leaders to build go-to-market approaches, shape and win opportunities, and accelerate the adoption of new solutions in their markets.

**Key Responsibilities

****Strategic Market Development

**

• Drive the execution of the European (and, by extension, APAC) growth strategy for our digitally enabled forensic solutions, aligned to global priorities and regional targets.

• Identify market opportunities, emerging regulatory trends and client needs to expand the solution portfolio across countries.

• Partner with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to build market plans, go-to-market approaches and priority pursuits.

• Develop practical playbooks, propositions, case studies and market materials that help countries accelerate revenue and client penetration.

• Track market performance and pipeline to focus effort where growth potential is greatest.

**

• Equip country leaders and teams to confidently position, sell and scale technology-enabled forensic solutions.

• Act as a trusted commercial advisor to country leaders establishing or expanding these offerings.

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and leading practices across Europe and APAC to build commercial momentum and consistency.

• Help local leaders understand — at the right level — how technology, analytics and AI translate into client value and competitive advantage.

**Client Engagement & Commercial Leadership

**

• Help countries shape complex proposals and solution approaches for priority opportunities.

• Identify cross-border opportunities and bring global capability to bear to win and deliver client work.

• Drive pipeline development and revenue growth across priority markets.

**Market Presence & Thought Leadership

**

• Represent the firm at client forums, industry events and internal leadership meetings.

• Champion the firm's perspective on technology-enabled, AI-enhanced forensic solutions.

• Develop market insights and commercial materials that support business development and portfolio growth.

• Deliver compelling presentations and demos for country leaders, practitioners and clients.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Build strong relationships with Regional and Country Forensics leaders to advance growth objectives.

• Influence senior stakeholders across geographies to back adoption and growth initiatives.

• Foster cross-region collaboration to share resources, opportunities and leading practices.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Demonstrated success in commercialising services and driving revenue growth within a professional services environment — ideally new or technology-enabled offerings.

• Proven ability to drive change and adoption across distributed, matrixed teams.

• Strong client network and market-facing relationships that can be leveraged.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and executive-level communication skills.

• Sufficient fluency in forensic technology and AI to speak credibly and connect capability to client value — deep hands-on technical expertise is not required.

**Preferred

**

• Knowledge of Integrity & Compliance disciplines (ABC, third-party risk, monitoring, investigations, ethics programmes).

• Awareness of advanced analytics and AI applications relevant to forensics and regulatory risk.

• Multilingual capabilities (English plus another major European language).

**Success Metrics

**

• Revenue growth and pipeline expansion across the forensic solution portfolio in Europe and APAC.

• Measurable shift from manual/traditional to technology-led delivery in priority markets measured through adoption of technology.

• Increased capability and participation of country teams in selling and delivering technology-enabled solutions.

• Growth in cross-border and multi-country engagements.

• Market-facing assets and thought leadership that support commercial growth.

**Working Model

**

• Hybrid across European hubs; travel 30–50% for client meetings, country activation and leadership forums.

Reports to [confirm exact global reporting line]; close collaboration with Global, Regional and Country Forensics leadership.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• 
You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• 
You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• 
You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• 
You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• 
You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• 
Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• 
A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• 
You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• 
You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• 
You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• 
You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• 
You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• 
Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• 
The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Digital Servicebook is a Danish automotive tech and SaaS company, founded in 2015. We make car service history digital, accessible and aggregated across car brands and connect independent workshops, car manufacturers' digital service registers and other players in the automotive industry.

Our platform is supported globally and is widely used in Europe. We have sales offices in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK and the Netherlands, are continuously working to expand our presence in more markets and collaborate with some of the biggest players in the industry.

We work purposefully with AI and new technologies that make everyday life easier and our processes more efficient. We are a small, dynamic organization in growth, and now our finance function must keep up.

About the position

You will be responsible for the entire day-to-day finance function – from vouchers and reconciliations to monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts. It is a hands-on role: you do the bookkeeping yourself, and you are also the one who gives the management and the board a true and timely picture of the finances.

You will work closely with the COO and management, and you will have a real influence on how we structure processes, systems and reporting as we grow.

Your primary tasks

• Ongoing bookkeeping, voucher management and reconciliation of bank, debtors, creditors and intermediate accounts

• Invoicing and customer follow-up across subscriptions, transaction-based services and payment flows (e.g. e-conomic and Stripe)

• Reconciliation between CRM, payment platform and accounting, so we know that all customers are invoiced correctly

• Month, quarterly and year-end closing as well as collaboration with the auditor

• VAT and duties, including VAT on sales abroad

• Coordination of payroll and payroll-related tasks, also for employees in other countries

• Controlling and monthly management and board reporting (profit, balance sheet and key figures)

• Preparation and follow-up on budget and ongoing forecast, including cash management

• Finances across companies and countries in the group

• Continuous improvement and automation of financial processes and systems

Your profile

• You have solid experience with independent bookkeeping and closing of accounts – preferably 5+ years

• You have experience with controlling, budgeting and forecasting and can translate numbers into clear recommendations

• Relevant education, accountant background or equivalent experience

• You are strong in Excel and have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• You are good at Danish and English in writing and speech

• It is an advantage if you have experience with SaaS/subscription finance, foreign companies or VAT across countries

• You are structured, accurate and self-driven – and you thrive on having both your hands in the bookkeeping and the overview of the whole

We offer

• A central role with great independence and direct influence in a growing company

• Short path to decisions and close cooperation with management

• An international industry in digital transformation

• Salary, according to qualifications,

• Working hours / flexibility

Apply →

The Impact You'll Make

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. jobs.occupation: Business Consultant, Investment, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will specialise in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant with an interest in digitalisation and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analysing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues. An interest in or basic knowledge of investment-related processes is an advantage.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals who will support your continuous development towards a role as subject matter expert within IT solutions for banking and investment. Over time, you will build deep domain knowledge and develop into a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analysing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimisation.

• 
Supporting the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with experienced colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management where relevant.

• 
Building domain knowledge through hands-on project experience and knowledge sharing, with the opportunity to develop into a subject matter expert over time.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• 
Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, ideally working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly you are motivated to build specialized domain knowledge.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalisation, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have an interest in or basic experience with investment-related processes, such as corporate actions. Previous experience within banking or investment is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Lead Consultant – Data Platforms & AI

• Full-time

• Office: Hellerup

Job Description

We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

What you’ll bring

You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• 
A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• 
Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• 
Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• 
Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• 
A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

What we offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

How to apply

• 
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• 
Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?
